statement: Agentic workflows improve code generation reliability by 20% compared to zero-shot prompting.
policy_implication: Default to multi-step agentic generation for complex tasks.

statement: Over-reliance on mock data in tests reduces production confidence.
policy_implication: Simulator priors should weigh end-to-end test results higher.

statement: End-to-end tests are 50% more flaky than unit tests.
policy_implication: Implement automatic retries for E2E simulator verification.

statement: LLM context window limits require aggressive token pruning for long-running tasks.
JSON schema validation prevents 95% of structured output parsing errors.
policy_implication: Mandate schema validation for all tool calls.

statement: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) gates increase task completion time but reduce critical failures by 80%.
Temperature 0.0 is optimal for code syntax generation.
policy_implication: Set default temperature to 0.0 for syntax-heavy tasks.

statement: Providing explicit error traces improves LLM debugging success rate.
policy_implication: Simulator must capture and pass full stack traces.

statement: Simulated environments drift from production APIs within 30 days on average.
policy_implication: Schedule simulator environment refreshes every 14 days.

statement: Concurrent subagent execution reduces latency but increases context collision risks.
policy_implication: Limit concurrent subagents to 5 unless isolated workspaces are used.
